purpose: Equivalent HN boundary QP residual centering/scaling; retain original estimation targets and all numeric qualification thresholds

software.SFA_corrected: equivalent stable HN/EXP likelihood; public SciPy L-BFGS-B/BFGS and HiGHS/Clarabel boundary subproblems
software.StoNED: unmodified pyStoNED 0.7.5 CNLS/IPOPT model plus explicit constrained QLE and stable conditional-score adapter

sfa.joint_starts: profile endpoints, every grid local likelihood maximum, and fresh sfaR baseline
boundaries: sigma_v=0 constrained HN QP or EXP LP
sfa.HN_boundary_coordinates: OLS-centered residual-RMS-normalized QR coordinates; recover original coefficients and duals before unchanged KKT checks

stoned.degenerate_rule: near-zero screen plus tighter two-start CNLS; tight RMS <= threshold and <= 0.1*base RMS; otherwise unresolved numerical classification
stoned.QLE_parameter_domain: rho in [0,1], with exact endpoint evaluation; no negative variance and no clipping
stoned.conditional_score: stable exact Mills-ratio formula without additive denominator constant

degenerate_reporting: Numerically unresolved/degenerate stochastic scale is separate from regular MLE and numerical failure. Preserve observed-only limiting frontier and TE=1 convention separately; do not label it an identified stochastic decomposition.
